proposed.explanation: Comparing the four companies on FY2025 performance and valuation: 1. Net Profit Growth (2024 to 2025): ETEL net profit grew by 123.30% (from 10,111,328,000 EGP to 22,578,063,000 EGP). EFID net profit grew by 67.75% (from 1,606,727,698 EGP to 2,695,301,670 EGP). COMI net profit grew by 48.87% (from 55,256,732,000 EGP to 82,258,815,000 EGP). TMGH achieved FY2025 net profit of 18,201,981,482 EGP with EPS growth of 59.36% (from 4.38 LE to 6.98 LE). 2. Price-to-Earnings (P/E) Ratios (at current prices and 2025 EPS): COMI is priced at 128.00 EGP with 2025 EPS of 18.25 EGP, giving a P/E of 7.01x. EFID is priced at 20.40 EGP with 2025 EPS of 2.18 EGP, giving a P/E of 9.36x. TMGH is priced at 82.50 EGP with 2025 EPS of 6.98 LE, giving a P/E of 11.82x. ETEL is priced at 141.95 EGP with 2025 EPS of 11.93 EGP, giving a P/E of 11.90x. COMI offers the most attractive valuation (7.01x P/E) combined with robust earnings growth (48.87%), making it ideal for a long-term growth investor with a 7+ year horizon. Purchasing 625 shares of COMI at 128.00 EGP equals exactly 80,000.00 EGP, fully deploying available cash.
